newsitem.title: USA: AT&T Capital posts lower Q1 net income, revenues.
newsitem.headline: AT&T Capital posts lower Q1 net income, revenues.

text.p: AT&T Capital Corp said Tuesday it posted first-quarter net income of $7.4 million, a sharp decrease from the $37.0 million reported the comparable period last year.
Total first-quarter revenues were $420.9 million compared to $439.3 million, a 4.2 percent decline.

The company, a former AT&T Corp unit, said it had expected the substantial earnings drop, which it attributed in part to its recent merger and related securitization activity that together reduced net income by between $35 million and $40 million.

"Lower earnings for the first quarter of 1997 were expected by management, given that last October's planned securitization removed a large amount of earning assets from our balance sheet and we experienced certain costs relating to our new capital structure," said Tom Wajnert, chairman and chief executive.
"Since our change in ownership in October 1996, we've been open about these short-term expectations along with our long-term enthusiasm for the company's strong business positioning."
AT&T Capital is a privately owned company that provides equipment leasing, financing and related services. The company said it owned assets totalling about $8.0 billion as of March 31.
